title: Zuno OKF profile 1.0: policy document
description: Frontmatter of agents/<name>/policies/<name>.md, a constraint that may only narrow the corp policies in a Zuno OKF profile 1.0 bundle: the upstream Open Knowledge Format 0.2 envelope (https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/open-knowledge-format/blob/main/SPEC.md) plus the namespaced `zuno` block. Frozen (zuno-demo ADR-0615): a change needs a new profile version.

okf_version.description: [OKF] Version of the upstream Open Knowledge Format this document follows (SPEC §12): always the quoted string "0.2". Repeated in every document so a reader can dispatch one file at a time (a declared deviation: upstream declares it once, in the bundle-root index.md).

type.description: [OKF] Document kind (SPEC §4): always "policy" in this schema.

resource.description: [OKF] Canonical URI of this document (SPEC §4): its file on the main branch of the repository that publishes it.

sources.description: [OKF] What the document was derived from (SPEC §5 provenance). Descriptive, never a grant: the tasks' declarations are the authorization surface.

generated.description: [OKF] How the content was produced (SPEC §5 trust): an actor (`human:<id>`, `process:<id>` or `<producer>/<version>`) and an instant.

verified.description: [OKF] Independent confirmations (SPEC §5 trust). Absent or empty: unverified; machine actors only: machine-confirmed; a `human:` actor: human-reviewed. Advisory, never a grant. Always a list (a declared deviation: upstream also tolerates a bare mapping).

status.description: [OKF] Lifecycle of the document (SPEC §5): absent means stable. For an agent it agrees with zuno.status: draft for placeholder, stable for active, deprecated for deprecated or retired.

stale_after.description: [OKF] Instant after which the content should be reviewed again (SPEC §5), with an offset.

zuno.description: [ZUNO EXT] The additional, narrowing-only constraint this note records.

profile.description: [ZUNO] Version of the Zuno OKF profile this document follows: always the quoted string "1.0" (zuno-demo ADR-0615).

narrows_platform_policy.description: Self-documenting guardrail: authoring a policy addendum is an explicit acknowledgment that it can only restrict what agent.okf.md/tasks/*.md and the root-level policies/ files already allow, never grant or widen it. Always true - there is no schema-legal way to write a widening addendum.

constraint_type.description: What kind of additional constraint this is.

applies_to.description: What this constraint narrows. `tasks` is required - a policy addendum with no task scope applies to nothing checkable. `tools`/`knowledge` further scope it to specific declarations those tasks already carry (their own `allowed_tools`/`allowed_knowledge`), never to a tool or domain the task doesn't already declare.

tasks.description: Task names (agents/<name>/tasks/<task>.md) this constraint applies to.

tools.description: Optional: restrict this constraint to specific tools among the listed tasks' `allowed_tools`.

knowledge.description: Optional: restrict this constraint to specific knowledge domains among the listed tasks' `allowed_knowledge`.

rationale.description: Why this constraint exists - the business, security or operational reason a maintainer would need to know before relaxing it.

enforcement.description: Whether anything actually enforces this constraint today, or whether it is agreed-but-manual.

mechanism.description: `manual-process`: enforced by human process/review, not code. `external-system`: enforced by a named system outside this repository's OKF-consuming services. `none-yet`: agreed but not enforced anywhere - a documented gap, not a false claim of enforcement.

notes.description: Free-text detail on the mechanism (which process, which system, or what would be needed to close a none-yet gap).
